programme.desc: It's pasta time again, so don't forget to salt the pasta water, and sauce your pasta the way the Italians do! Lidia prepares a pasta primavera, then a cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass

programme.title: Food Safari
programme.desc: Maeve O'Meara enters the saffron-scented realm of Persian food - one of the most ancient cuisines on earth. She discovers the secrets to cooking tender kebabs, how the rosewater iced dessert faloodeh is made, and why the Persian rice dish zereshk polow is so adored.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Dive into chocolate delights in this unmissable episode! Kirsten crafts hazelnut torrone, chocolate-orange financiers, and minty chocolate biscuits.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

programme.desc: Tony examines the meeting point of Asian, Mexican, and Latino culture in modern Los Angeles. He talks to Roy Choi, a Korean-American who created a Brave New World of gastronomy with his LA based Kogi trucks. Roy’s food reflects a new American idea of "natural" fusion - culinary influences that grew up next to and with each other.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Comte is one of the most popular cheeses in France and the most important of all those made under the strict French appellation system. This sweet nutty concentrated cheese is still made using traditional methods that date back 700 years high in the Alps that border France and Switzerland. Will Studd traces the important links between farmer, cheese maker, and affineur.

It seems that justice will be done quickly until Bill gets an intimidating note telling him that he better not testify against the man in custody or it will be the worst for him. Supported by his wife and son, and not easily frightened, Bill decides to ignore the threat and demands protection from Frost.

A short drive brings them to their next activity: making a their very own terrarium - a miniature garden in glass. Leaving Robson's Hexham home, the pair head to a farm nearby to pick gooseberries for a lesson in jam making. A skill his little brother - who was a scaffolder by trade - is already well versed in. A short drive brings them to their next activity: making a their very own terrarium - a miniature garden in glass. After a night in the Northumbrian countryside the pair head to Druridge Bay - a seven-mile stretch of uninterrupted beach. There, they help build a gigantic sandcastle complete with turrets.

programme.title: Robson Green's Weekend Escapes

He takes the former Lioness tree climbing and canoeing before signing them up for bushcraft where they learn how to light a fire with sticks and eat a campfire supper. Robson heads into Upper Swaledale in North Yorkshire for a waterfall swim and sauna.

programme.title: Ancient Greece By Train

Guests include Busted's Charlie Simpson, pop star Pixie Lott, and comedian John Kearns who does his best to take the Intros rounds new heights. Expect all the classic rounds and a whole load of chaos as the teams battle it out.

While several women are raped in her town, Arlette Caruso, the communist mayor of a small industrial town in the Sambre, decides to break the silence around these rapes to warn the local female population. She pushes a victim, one of her municipal employees, to testify publicly about her rape. Meanwhile, the rapist continues to be rampant.

Their secret relationship is soon discovered by Carla, and a love triangle begins. Stars Astrid Berges-Frisbey, Alvaro Cervantes and Llorenc Gonzalez.

As their girls' mother lies sick in the hospital, O Totoro brings the sisters on a magical adventure but also helps them to understand the realities of life.
